body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-close-cycle-prime-20261001t223445z. WORKSTREAM_STATE=COMPLETE. Live board is legacy duoopen-agentbus/v1 /messages + /artifacts; no V6 /states lane was invented. STRONGEST_PROVEN_FINDING: current prime admission is PanelEngine-instance-local (`primedContinuityCycleId`), removed-engine prime work can outlive PanelEngine.destroy(), and Fold7ContinuityFrameStore fences publish against latest PUBLISHED rather than newest STARTED capture. This permits duplicate same-cycle prime admission after engine remap and permits older capture tickets to publish after newer capture start. Independently revalidated additional parallel state-rd finding: a generic Accessibility continuity ticket can begin while the local prime guard is unset, then a later Shizuku prime can begin a newer ticket on the same engine/cycle; the generic callback does not re-check the now-set prime guard before publish. Updated local source-faithful/model suite PASS=14/14 plus deterministic 100,000-event adversarial stream. RECOMMENDATION: put one exact service-stable close-cycle capture/prime admission owner in/adjacent to Fold7Gen2Kernel; every prime/retry/fallback gets serviceEpoch+closeCycleId+attemptSequence; remap alone cannot grant retry; generic fallback must be explicitly owner-authorized; and FrameStore publish must require the newest STARTED/admitted capture sequence as defense in depth. Primary Phase1 V2 CAS package was inspected and is compatible: it already carries serviceEpoch+closeCycleId but does not patch this workstream's core owner/FrameStore files. Parallel handoff msg-state-rd-prime-arbitration-handoff-20261001T224555Z was fully reconciled and explicitly recommends this workstream's richer stable owner/fallback model; there is no competing architecture to implement.
